title: #122 Environment Effect
prompt: Some people say that people are defined by the place where they grew up, but some argue that the environment only has little effect. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Use a celebrity you know to support your opinion.

promptSegments.text: Some people say that people are defined by the place where they grew up, but some argue that the environment only has little effect.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Use a celebrity you know to support your opinion.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The community and family a person lives with teach them many things in daily life, as demonstrated by famous actors who grew up in big cities and learned to talk to many different kinds of people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The community and family a person lives with teach them many things in daily life, as demonstrated by famous actors who grew up in big cities and learned to talk to many different kinds of people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The surroundings influence a person's interests and habits; for instance, a child near the sea might develop a strong interest in water sports and outdoor activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The surroundings influence a person's interests and habits; for instance, a child near the sea might develop a strong interest in water sports and outdoor activities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The local setting significantly shapes a person's personality, as demonstrated by a child living near the sea who might develop an interest in ocean activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The local setting significantly shapes a person's personality, as demonstrated by a child living near the sea who might develop an interest in ocean activities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A place provides crucial life skills because different areas require different kinds of work, such as farming, which teaches manual skills and an understanding of nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A place provides crucial life skills because different areas require different kinds of work, such as farming, which teaches manual skills and an understanding of nature.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Growing up in a specific place, such as a busy city, teaches people how to manage crowds and fast life, thereby showing that the environment plays a major role in shaping a person's character.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Growing up in a specific place, such as a busy city, teaches people how to manage crowds and fast life, thereby showing that the environment plays a major role in shaping a person's character.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The local environment influences social habits because the available resources and activities guide how people interact, such as a coastal town encouraging outdoor sports.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The local environment influences social habits because the available resources and activities guide how people interact, such as a coastal town encouraging outdoor sports.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on how the physical setting (community/city) influences practical skills and adaptability.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on how the physical setting (community/city) influences practical skills and adaptability.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on how the social setting (family/friends/nature) influences moral values and beliefs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on how the social setting (family/friends/nature) influences moral values and beliefs.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the extent to which a person's upbringing and environment influence their personality and identity, using a celebrity example to support the argument.
outline: Introduction: Present the debate on whether people are defined by their place of upbringing or not.
Body 1: Discuss the influence of upbringing and environment on personality, citing examples from the celebrity's life.
Body 2: Argue the counterpoint that inherent traits play a role, using the celebrity's natural talents or personality as evidence.
Conclusion: Summarize the arguments and state the overall stance on the influence of environment versus inherent traits.
keyArguments: The environment significantly influences a person's development and personality, as seen in the celebrity's upbringing.
Inherent traits and natural abilities also play a crucial role in shaping an individual, complementing the effects of the environment.

plan.focus: Discuss the extent to which a person's upbringing and environment influence their personality and identity, using a celebrity example to support the argument.
outline: Introduction: Present the debate on whether people are defined by their place of upbringing or not.
Body 1: Discuss the influence of upbringing and environment on personality, citing examples from the celebrity's life.
Body 2: Argue the counterpoint that inherent traits play a role, using the celebrity's natural talents or personality as evidence.
Conclusion: Summarize the arguments and state the overall stance on the influence of environment versus inherent traits.
keyArguments: The environment significantly influences a person's development and personality, as seen in the celebrity's upbringing.
Inherent traits and natural abilities also play a crucial role in shaping an individual, complementing the effects of the environment.
